__NOTOC__{{Recipe summary
| Category = Pie recipes
| Time = 40 minutes
| Image = [[Image:Aubergine_onion_pie.jpg|300px]]
| Servings = 4–6 servings
}}

{{recipe}}

This is a vegetable [[Cookbook:Pie|pie]] using tomatoes, aubergines (eggplant), onions, and mushrooms. You can make vegetable pie with many kinds of vegetables.

== Ingredients ==
=== Crust ===
* 250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 100 g (0.4 cups) medium-soft [[Cookbook:butter|butter]] (leave it out for a half-hour before making the crust)
* 1 [[Cookbook:egg|egg]]
* Lukewarm water
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:salt|salt]]
=== Filling ===
*1–2 [[Cookbook:Eggplant|aubergine]]s (eggplants)
*1–2 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]s
*4 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]]es
*150 g (0.6 cups) of [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushroom]]s
*Grated [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]
*[[Cookbook:Milk|Milk]]
*1 [[Cookbook:egg|egg]] yolk
*Fresh [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]

== Procedure ==
=== Crust ===
# Add the flour to a large bowl.
# Add the butter, and rub it into the dough with your fingers until the pastry is nearly consistent in texture.
# Add the egg, then some water bit by bit while working the pastry with your hands until it becomes soft and smooth. It should not be sticky, and it should look shiny and medium-yellow.

=== Filling ===
# Cut the vegetables into thin [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]]. 
# Brown the vegetables in oil or butter or steam them, starting with the onions and aubergines (eggplant), then the mushrooms. Keep the tomatoes raw.

=== Assembly ===
# [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll]] the dough out about ⅛–¼ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick.
# Butter a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]] and fit the dough into the pan. Prick the dough all over with a fork, and line it with some [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]] in a curved shape.
# Pre-[[Cookbook:Bake|bake]] the crust for about 10 minutes in a medium [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]. 
# Take the crust out of the oven, and arrange the vegetables over the crust in whatever arrangement pleases you.
# In a bowl, mix the egg yolk with some milk and a bit of fresh cream, then pour the mixture on top of the vegetables. 
# Cover with grated cheese. 
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15–20 minutes in a [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|medium]] [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]].
